answers.reason: A junior professor does not hold a central leadership office or a full chair required to sit in the university senate.
The budget planning round is a central allocation body reserved for university leadership and faculty heads.
A fixed-term junior professor does not hold the higher rank required to select candidates for vacant professorships in a rank-based system.
As a holder of a professorship in the faculty, the junior professor has sufficient academic rank to participate in the faculty council.
As a professor who teaches in the faculty, the junior professor is eligible to take part in faculty-level teaching committees.
Holding a professorial office that involves teaching entitles the junior professor to sit on the faculty's examination board.
As a professor building a research group, the junior professor holds sufficient rank within the faculty to participate in internal research funding decisions.
A junior professor who teaches in the faculty is permitted to take part in working groups that revise degree programme modules.
As a professor who teaches and leads research, the junior professor outranks or sits at the level of operational teaching laboratory decisions.
Because those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, a junior professor is permitted to join the lowest-level planning rounds.
